READ-ONLY re-review of fixes applied to the Phase 1 Foundation & Scaffold (Phaser 3 + TS strict + Vite, landscape 1280x720). Do NOT modify files. A fix pass addressed findings from two prior reviews — verify each is correctly resolved and nothing regressed:
1. iOS/mobile audio-unlock is now registered on a LONG-LIVED window/document listener (NOT PreloadScene's short-lived input emitter), calls an idempotent resume() on the first real gesture, survives scene transitions, and removes itself after firing. Confirm the old short-lived PreloadScene binding is gone.
2. `ui_progress_bar` and `ui_score_icon` are now actually DISPLAYED (score icon beside the score; progress-bar frame rendered from the SVG image with a fill over it) — no manifest key is loaded-but-unused.
3. `scripts/gen-placeholders.mjs` no longer duplicates the manifest as an independent source (derives from `assetManifest.ts` as the single source, OR a loud fail-fast mismatch guard exists). All 34 greybox SVGs still present + well-formed.
4. GameScene jump input is scoped so tapping the debug Win/Lose buttons doesn't also jump.
5. ResultsScene.create has a safe default/guard for missing data.
6. MenuScene no longer overlaps a duplicate title text on the logo image.
7. gameConfig LEVEL_LENGTH comment corrected; vite chunkSizeWarningLimit raised (build emits no >500 kB advisory).
8. Asset-manifest KEYS + DIMENSIONS are UNCHANGED from the 34-entry contract (verify the array wasn't altered).
9. Independently run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build`; report BOTH pass (paste key result lines).
Also scan for any NEW regressions or dead code introduced by the fixes.
RETURN: per-item PASS/FAIL with file cites, any regression noted, and a one-line overall verdict (is Phase 1 ready to close?).

The `MISS` entries are regex false positives — my `t('` pattern matched the trailing `t('` of `asset('...')` and `createElement('div')`. Let me re-check i18n keys cleanly with a word-boundary anchor.

Clean now: all 19 real `t()` keys resolve; the only orphan is `menu_title` (made unused by the item-6 fix). Let me run a few final targeted greps to confirm no stray dead code from the fixes.

All verifications complete. Let me finalize the task and report.

5	 * `scripts/gen-placeholders.mjs` reads the same key/width/height set to emit the
6	 * Phase-1 greybox SVGs. Phase 2 REPLACES the SVG files against these EXACT keys

8	 * art and any code that positions the sprite.

12	 *  - Keys are stable & namespaced (`dog_*`, `park_*`, `ui_*`, `vfx_*`, ...).
